versions.changelog:
- Added a video preview section to SKILL.md for visual demonstration of Grok Scraper in action.
- No changes to functionality or code; documentation update only.

Initial release of grok-scraper — a zero-cost tool for Grok AI queries via browser automation:

- Uses Playwright and an X Premium account to execute Grok queries without an X API KEY.
- Requires OpenClaw and a local or GUI environment (not headless/cloud).
- Simple CLI workflow: check login state, run script, and read output.
- Automatically handles retries, session expiry, and DOM selector changes.
- Includes error codes and guides for fixing extraction issues due to X.com front-end updates.
